rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when each party does the same thing to the other.

example.english: We need to mutually respect each other and stop arguing.
example.traditional: 我哋兩個要互相尊重，唔好再鬧交。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 zyun1 zung6 m4 hou2 zoi3 naau6 gaau1

rows.jyutping: deoi3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 hou2 cyu3
rows.note: Use this when something benefits all the people or sides involved, as in “mutually beneficial.”

example.english: This cooperation plan is mutually beneficial, and both sides save time.
example.traditional: 呢個合作方案對大家都有好處，兩邊都慳到時間。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hap6 zok3 fong1 on3 deoi3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 hou2 cyu3 loeng5 bin1 dou1 haan1 dou3 si4 gaan1
